g.text: Professional aerospace engineering blueprint - General arrangement, system layout, and longitudinal section

Views: Top / Side / Front / Rear / Cutaway
Concept schematic only - not for fabrication
Z+ up | Longitudinal section reference A-A shown in orange
Top airlock hatch - EVA / IVA ingress
Deployable solar arrays - 2 x 12 m wings
Y+ left | Z+ up | Longitudinal section line A-A in orange

1. Common station geometry retained across all orthographic views.
2. Solar arrays shown deployed; radiators and antennas in nominal flight configuration.
3. Cutaway illustrates cockpit, avionics, airlock, cargo bay, propellant tanks, and thrust frame.
4. Landing gear shown extended for ground servicing / landing configuration.
5. Dimensions are nominal and intended for visualization only.
